visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a white sleeveless dress stands in an indoor room with red curtains. An older woman in a red and grey sari performs a ritual by circling a brass tray with a lit oil lamp in front of the woman's torso. (2) The woman in white sits at a wooden desk across from an Indian doctor in a light blue sari. They are in a bright office with papers, a laptop, and framed certificates on the wall. (3) The scene shifts to a spa-like room with bamboo walls and blue neon floor lighting. The woman sits on a white chair, dipping her bare feet into a shallow tub of water. (4) The woman is wrapped in a white towel, receiving a head massage from two therapists wearing yellow uniforms and face masks. She looks at the camera, smiling, and makes a peace sign with her hand. (5) A close-up shot shows a circular dough ring placed on the woman's abdomen. A person's hand pours a dark, viscous herbal oil into the ring while she lies down. (6) The woman, wearing a white t-shirt, sits in a bamboo-cladded room and takes a sip from a small pink cup of tea, looking relaxed. (7) The final phase shows the woman outdoors on a paved path lined with tall, slender trees. She stretches her arms upward toward the bright, sunny sky. The camera pans across a wide green lawn and a small building under clear weather.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 阿育吠陀探索之旅 Ayurveda Journey. (2) [Subtitle]: 歡迎我來，祝福的儀式. (3) [Subtitle]: 每天的問診，阿育吠陀講究的是生活的科學. (4) [Subtitle]: 探索現在的你，為何跟本質的你不一樣了. (5) [Subtitle]: 有時候需要身體慢一點，心才能夠跟上. (6) [Subtitle]: 放鬆身體是修復的好幫手. (7) [Subtitle]: 鼻子蒸氣中，因為我有點小感冒. (8) [Subtitle]: 好有儀式感的按摩前奏曲. (9) [Subtitle]: 被好好照顧，也好好照顧自己的感覺，好好. (10) [Subtitle]: 當草本熱油滲入肌膚，呼吸漸漸放慢. (11) [Subtitle]: 據說這是在促進胃部消化... (12) [Subtitle]: 按摩後喝杯檸草本茶特別舒服. (13) [Subtitle]: 慢下來，身體都變輕盈了. (14) [Subtitle]: 這幾天就幻想，自己住在森林裡吧. (15) [Subtitle]: 有時候跑慢一點，回到原廠設定能夠走更久.
